caption: With both listeners plain, the button's target handler prints first and the div's bubble handler second — two lines. Set the div to capture and the same two handlers print in the opposite order; call stopPropagation() in the button and the div never runs, so only one line prints.

spec.aria: Three timelines of the click on button#b inside div#outer: in (a) the button handler runs then the div handler, in (b) only the button handler runs, in (c) the div's capture handler runs then the button handler.
